survey.notes: 14 of 55 known pages surveyed (sitemap exhausted). Site-wide: sticky header 100%, pixel icons 100%, current-page cursor marker 93%, stepped looping animation 86%, pixel-art illustration 86%. 'layout:logo-wall' (71%) is a false positive: repeated small SVG sprites (conifers in banner/footer strip, sidebar category icons), no third-party logos. Mid: table 43%, code block 36%, disclosure 36%, quote 36% (articles). One-offs: card grid 21%, motion:svg 14%, badge 14%, 'theme-toggle' 14% (actually the pixel-body-font on/off switch), line-drawing 7% (recharts bars on /vitals), tabs 7% (code file tabs). The site is dark-only.

character.summary: A 16-bit console game booted up as a documentation site: night-blue ground, cream text in one pixel typeface for Hangul and Latin, and hard-edged game windows (4px frame, 0 radius, hard black offset shadow) holding the content. Every page opens on a small living pixel diorama whose stars, lights, smoke and snow move only in stepped frames (steps(1)..steps(360), never tweened), while the UI reacts instantly (0ms transitions) with an RPG menu cursor, a gold 4px focus ring and buttons that drop 2-4px when pressed. Under the costume the reading surface is calm and dense: 720px prose at 16/28, tables and code windows with no art inside.

color.notes: Dark-only reference (root class 'dark', color-scheme dark). Every UI colour has channels in multiples of 8 (15-bit console palette); scene art uses 3-digit 12-bit hex (--art-*). Gold accent area 0.01%: one filled primary button per screen at most (home only), the cursor and the focus ring. Surfaces stack bg #181820 -> surface #202028 -> sel #282838; windows go darker (#101018) inside a 4px #888898 frame. Category hues only as 4px bars, 6px bullets and icon fills. Text never pure white, ground never pure black. A light 'day' appearance is derived (roles prefixed 'light (derived)') with the same quantization; gold stays as fill with #181820 ink.

motion.reducedMotion: Reference: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation and transition is set to none and .sprite-anim images are hidden in favour of .sprite-still PNGs (motion.json reducedMotionRules); a header 'animation on/off' switch also pauses the scene. Template: the same — honour the media query, freeze every loop on frame 1, swap animated sprites for stills, and ship a persisted 'animation off' switch.
motion.notes: Every animation on the site uses steps(n); travel is quantized to the pixel unit (800px/200 steps, 1440px/360, 128px/32 = 4px per step). UI transitions are 0s everywhere (interactions.json base.transitionDuration). No load, entrance or scroll animations (reveals empty); header static on scroll. Unused shipped keyframes confirm the vocabulary: pixel-nudge translate(2px), pixel-drift-wide, pixel-twinkle.

layout.grid: Wide pages (home, vitals) max 1302px; prose column 720-740px; about 880px. theming.notes: Dark-only: html.dark and color-scheme dark on all 7 captured pages; the single prefers-color-scheme rule is a lightningcss compile artifact (--lightningcss-dark: initial), supportsDark false, no theme toggle or selectors. The survey's ui:theme-toggle (2 pages) is the article-header 'pixel body font on/off' switch; the header also has an 'animation on/off' switch — both reader preferences, kept by the template. Template: night (dark) is default and canonical; a light 'day' appearance is derived (same 8-step quantization, parchment ground #e8e0d0, ink #383040, frames #383040, gold kept as fill, gold text #705000) and exposed via prefers-color-scheme plus a [data-theme] toggle; scene art swaps its sky ramp.

imagery.iconography: 24x24 (UI, category) and 12x12 (file tree, chevrons) pixel icons drawn on a 2px grid (12x12 units at 24px), fill only, no strokes, one flat colour each (category hue or text-muted). Glyphs: search, pause, font-switch, warning, check, folder, file, chevrons, per-category emblems. The ▶ cursor is a 4x7-unit beveled mask (white .45 top edge, black .4 bottom edge) in left/right/up/down variants (--cur-*-shape/-shade).
imagery.illustration: Pixel art from filled 1-unit rect paths (no strokes, no curves, no gradients) authored on a coarse viewBox and scaled by integers (hero 488x130 at 4x; banners 720x128 at 2x). Sky as 4-9 flat bands from a 12-bit ramp joined by 2px checker dither rows; stepped-polyline hills; silhouettes one value darker; sprites with a 1-unit near-black outline and 2-tone shading; single-unit lights that blink. Layers reused via <use> (mirrored/clipped scene extensions, trees placed by x). Small drawings 16x40 to 80x80 px (conifers, moon with dither halo, cloud, seated figure, avatar on sunset tile).
imagery.photography: None. Animated pixel GIF/WebP sprites (coin, sparkle, star, walking character) from a third-party GIF library with still PNG fallbacks for reduced motion; charts restyled flat with square-ended bars and square legend bullets.

signatures.name: The living pixel stage (diorama)
signatures.what: A low-resolution pixel scene scaled by an integer factor sits at the top of every page (home: full-bleed 520px hero at 4x, viewBox 488x130 -> 1952x520; articles/categories: 256px banner at 2x inside a 4px #888898 game window) and a 32px grass ground strip with sprites closes every page. Built only from filled rect paths (94 fills, 0 strokes on the hero), sky as 12-bit colour bands (--art-sky-1..9 #002..#ea4) joined by 2px checker dither, stepped-polyline hills, small sprites (conifers, moon, cloud, seated figure) and single-unit blinking lights.
signatures.frequency: Scene or banner on 12/14 surveyed pages (svg:illustration 86%); the ground strip on every captured page; docs index and the metrics dashboard carry only the strip.
signatures.recipe: 1) Pick a pixel unit: 4px for a full-bleed hero, 2px for banners, card art and icons. Author the SVG at 1 unit = 1 viewBox unit and scale via width/height (e.g. viewBox 0 0 360 64 drawn at 1440x256). Set shape-rendering='crispEdges' on SVG, image-rendering: pixelated on rasters. 2) Draw only filled axis-aligned runs: <path d='M x y h w v h h -w z'> or <rect> on integer coordinates; no strokes, curves, gradients or alpha blending inside the art except dither. 3) Sky/ground: 4-9 flat horizontal bands from a 3-digit (12-bit) hex ramp; join neighbours with a one-unit checkerboard row of both colours; hills/horizons are stepped polylines with 4-8 unit steps. 4) Silhouette layers one value darker than the band behind; near objects get one highlight (top-left) and one shade (bottom-right), max 3 tones per object. 5) Add 1-2 hero sprites 12-20 units tall with a 1-unit #101018 outline and 3-6 single-unit lights that will blink; choose subjects from the product's own world (server rack, mailbox, greenhouse, lighthouse) — never the reference's cabin, poplar, figure or walking character. 6) Frame banners in a game window: border 4px solid line-strong, interior surface.window #101018, title block below the art inside the same frame; heroes run full-bleed with the window floating over the left third. 7) Footer ground strip: 32px band of the ground colour with a 2px lighter checker texture, 6px darker edge band, 2-4 sprites standing on it; pointer-events none, aria-hidden.
signatures.motion: Loop, all steps(): stars opacity 1 -> .35 -> 1 at steps(1) 2400ms; LEDs opacity 1 <-> .15 at 900/1400/2300ms with negative delays; smoke translate(0,0) -> (-16px,-36px) + fade over 5000ms steps(10); snow layer translateY(0 -> 128px) 6000ms steps(32) on a 2x-tall tile; cloud translateX(-80 -> 720px) 120000ms steps(200); far band translateX(0 -> -1440px) 300000ms steps(360); a meteor visible in the last 4% of a 14000ms cycle; footer sprite as an animated image. Reduced motion: every loop stops on frame 1, animated images swap to stills.

signatures.name: Stepped motion (frames, not tweens)
signatures.what: Every CSS animation on the site uses a steps() timing function — steps(1) for blinks, swaps and bobs, steps(10) to steps(360) for travel — and travel is quantized to the pixel unit (800px/200 steps, 1440px/360, 128px/32 = 4px per step). UI transitions are 0s on every captured element, so states switch on the next frame.
signatures.frequency: 12/14 surveyed pages animate (86%); 100% of captured animations are stepped; 100% of captured interactive elements have transition-duration 0s.
signatures.recipe: Tokens: --ease-blink: steps(1); travel uses steps(N) with N = distance in px / pixel unit (4px). Keyframes may only change opacity, translate() in whole-unit multiples, scale() for sparkle, or swap a background colour — no fractional rotation, no blur, no filter. Idle bob for any sprite or avatar: @keyframes idle { 50% { transform: translateY(-4px) } } 1000ms steps(1) infinite. Blink: @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: .15 } } at 900/1400/2300ms with negative delays so neighbours desync. Sparkle: scale(1) -> .34 at 70% -> 1 at 85% over 3200ms steps(1). Rare event: a long cycle (14000ms) with the visible part compressed into its last 4%. UI: transition: none on buttons, links, cards, rows, tabs and disclosures (override framework defaults). Provide a header switch 'animation on/off' (pause pixel glyph + label + state word) that sets animation-play-state: paused on the stage and swaps animated sprites for stills; persist the choice in localStorage.
signatures.motion: Triggers: loop (ambient art and status lights) and state-change (instant UI swap). Durations 500-300000ms; easings steps(1), steps(10), steps(32), steps(200), steps(360). No load, scroll or reveal animation.

signatures.limits: No ease, ease-in-out, cubic-bezier or spring anywhere. No scroll-driven or entrance animation. Loops only in art and status lights, never on text, buttons or data. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes every animation and transition and swaps sprites to stills; the 'animation off' switch does the same on demand.

signatures.name: RPG menu cursor and instant, physical interaction
signatures.what: A 4x7-unit pixel triangle drawn at 2px per unit (8x14px) in gold #d8a848 with a bevel (top-left edge white at 45%, bottom-left edge black at 40%) defined as CSS mask SVGs (--cur-right/left/up/down-shape and -shade). It marks the current item in header nav, sidebar and table of contents, appears before a card title on hover, and serves as the disclosure chevron. Press moves controls physically: 2px for bordered buttons, 4px for the gold button which loses its hard shadow. Focus is a 4px solid gold outline offset 3px (rows: -4px inside).
signatures.frequency: Current-page marker on 13/14 pages (93%); press offsets on every captured button on all 7 pages; identical gold focus ring on all 56 captured interactions.
signatures.recipe: Cursor: inline SVG viewBox='0 0 4 7' shape-rendering='crispEdges' with rows 1,2,3,4,3,2,1 units wide, used as mask-image on a span with background: currentColor so it takes the accent; layer a second span with the shade SVG (white .45 on the upper diagonal, black .4 on the lower). Size 8x14px (2px units); 6x10px for 12px text. Left/up/down variants are separate row data, not CSS rotation. Position absolutely 8px left of the label, vertically centred, with reserved space so labels never shift. Colour: accent for current/selected, text-hi for hover preview on cards. States (all transition: none): hover -> background #282838 on rows, nav items and ghost buttons; cards #202028 -> #282838 plus cursor before the title; links -> text-hi. Press -> translate: 2px 2px for bordered or ghost controls; shadowed buttons translate 4px 4px and drop box-shadow to none. Focus-visible -> outline: 4px solid accent; outline-offset: 3px (full-width rows and summaries: -4px). Current -> cursor + text-hi (+ #282838 bg in the sidebar). Open -> chevron swaps right -> down in one frame, summary tinted, left bar cyan.
signatures.motion: Instant state change, 0ms. Optional derived 2-frame blink of the single 'you are here' cursor (opacity 1 <-> 0, steps(1), 1000ms); the reference cursor is static.

signatures.name: Game-window chrome: hard frames, hard shadow, dithered rules, block meters
signatures.what: Windows with a 4px #888898 frame and a darker #101018 interior (home dialog, every banner, every code block with a 40px #202028 title bar); one hard 4px 4px 0 #000 shadow (100% of shadows); a 4px 2px-checker rule under the header (#303040) and under every article H2 (#686878); 2px dotted separators every 6px in the sidebar; a 4px category-hue top bar on cards from an 8-hue set; scores as 20 separate blocks (12x16px, 4px gaps) — an HP bar; callouts with a 4px semantic left bar and pixel icon. Radius 0 and borders only 0/2/4px.
signatures.frequency: Header dither rule 14/14; window frames on 12/14 (hero, banners); code windows on 5 (36%); colour bars on home, docs index, about, vitals; block meters on /vitals.
signatures.recipe: Borders: 2px (controls, inputs, small buttons) and 4px (windows, top bars, callout bars, active tab) only; radius 0 everywhere. Window: border 4px solid var(--line-strong); background var(--surface-window); optional 40px title bar on var(--surface) separated by a 2px var(--line) rule. Dither rule: a 4px-tall element with background: repeating-conic-gradient(var(--line) 0 25%, transparent 0 50%) 0 0 / 4px 4px (two rows of 2px checks); heading rule uses var(--line-ui), full content width, 12px below the heading. Dotted separator: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line-ui) 2px, transparent 2px) 0 0 / 6px 2px. Block meter: 10-20 flat blocks 12x16px with 4px gaps, filled in the status colour, empty in var(--sel), 48px pixel numeral above. Hard shadow: box-shadow 4px 4px 0 0 #000 only on the single primary action. Category hues: 8 saturated hues assigned one per entity, used as a 4px top bar, a 6px square bullet and the icon fill only.
signatures.motion: Static; block meters fill one block per frame when data arrives (derived: steps(N) over N x 40ms).

signatures.name: Pixel type for Hangul and Latin
signatures.what: One OFL pixel typeface sets all text (headings, body, buttons, nav, tables) at weight 400 only (100%), sizes 16px (98%), 32, 48 and rarely 12px, letter-spacing normal; line-heights 28 (prose) and 24 (UI) for 16px, 40 for 32px, 56 for 48px. A matching pixel mono sets code (26% of text). Hangul is drawn on the same bitmap grid as Latin so mixed Korean/English lines keep one rhythm. Emphasis is by colour (#d0c8c0 -> #f0e8d8), never weight. Articles offer a 'pixel body on/off' switch.
signatures.recipe: Primary Galmuri11 (OFL) for UI and body, Galmuri Mono (OFL) for code; or NeoDunggeunmo/DungGeunMo (OFL) for a 16px grid. Size only at integer multiples of the face's design grid (16-grid: 16/32/48, 12 for meta) and set -webkit-font-smoothing: none so edges stay hard. Scale: caption 12/18, body 16/28 (prose) and 16/24 (UI, tables, lists), h3 16/24 text-hi, h2 32/40, article h1 32/40, page/hero h1 48/56, numerals 48/56. Weight 400 always, letter-spacing normal, text-transform none. Hangul: word-break: keep-all, line-break: strict, keep 28px leading for prose; fallback 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', 'Malgun Gothic', 'Noto Sans KR', sans-serif. Readability switch 'pixel body on/off': off swaps prose and table cells to Pretendard (OFL) at 16/28 while headings, nav, buttons and numerals stay pixel. Inline code on #383010 with text-hi.

applicationMap.use: 48px pixel numerals with 16px units; labels 16/24.
16/24 pixel cells; readable sans when pixel body is off.
Labels and helpers 16/24 and 12/18; errors in danger colour.
Section titles 32/40, options 16/24.
One or two sentences 16/28 in text-muted.
48/56 headline, 16/28 lead.

signatures.limits: Never bold or italic; never sizes between integer steps (no 14/18/20/24 for a 16-grid face). Long prose (more than two screens) must offer the readable-body switch.

writing.casing: No text-transform; Latin technical terms keep their native case inside Korean text.
writing.tone: Korean polite declarative (formal '-합니다' in docs, softer '-해요' in the intro); calm, factual, no exclamation marks or emoji.
writing.notes: Headings are short noun phrases without punctuation; series titles use '(n)' and an em dash before the subtitle. Buttons are noun + verb with a trailing pixel ▶ for forward actions; switches read 'label + state word'. Meta joins items with a middle dot and puts units after numbers; dates YYYY.MM.DD in pixel numerals; keyboard hints as kbd chips; empty states are one plain muted sentence.

doNot: Use any easing other than steps(n) for animation, or any UI transition longer than 0ms.
Add border radius, blurred or coloured soft shadows, glassmorphism or gradients outside dithered art bands.
Use bold, italic or non-integer sizes of the pixel font, or add letter-spacing.
Use a smooth proportional sans for headings, nav or numerals (the readable-body switch only affects prose and table cells).
Put scene art behind text, controls, charts or table rows, or more than one scene per screen.
Use the gold accent for anything but the single primary action, the cursor and the focus ring.
Use pure white text or a pure black ground.
Draw illustrations with strokes, curves or anti-aliased edges, or scale pixel art by non-integer factors.
Replace the block meter with a smooth rounded progress bar or a spinner.
Use plain 1px hairlines under section headings instead of the dithered rule.

All Korean copy: headings, intro sentences, category names and descriptions, article titles, credits text.
The specific category emblems (boxed TS/JS letters, bracket glyphs) — draw new category glyphs.

Fonts: the observed pixel Korean font and its code variant are SIL OFL 1.1 (not proprietary) but the template defaults to Galmuri11 / Galmuri Mono (OFL) to avoid an identical voice; Pretendard and Geist Mono (OFL) for the readable body.
